items.description: About Asensus Surgical TransEnterix, which rebranded as Asensus Surgical in 2021, pursued the goal of challenging Intuitive Surgical in the robotic surgery market. After the FDA rejected its SurgiBot system in 2016, the company pivoted to the Senhance platform, a digital laparoscopy system featuring haptic feedback and eye-tracking camera control. Despite building a global procedure base, Asensus faced persistent financial difficulties and going-concern doubts, ultimately being acquired by KARL STORZ in 2024. The acquisition marked the end of Asensus as an independent entity, with its Senhance technology now folded into KARL STORZ's broader surgical portfolio. Asensus Surgical fell victim to a cyberattack, resulting in the theft of more than 600 GB of data and over 85,000 files containing confidential information, employees’ personal documents, research findings, and all of the company’s internal information.

About The Excalibur Group The Excalibur Group is a Washington D.C. based company that focuses on enhancing local, state, and federal programs through staff augmentation, training, and program management in the Defense, IT, Workforce, Environmental, and Legal sectors. They provide specialized job training and placement services for individuals in various industries, including transitioning soldiers. The company also offers both permanent and contingent labor to support clients' internal IT and R&D projects. Their mission is to deliver efficient contract management and cost-effective solutions while promoting meaningful Veteran employment. Company The Excalibur Group was attacked, resulting in the theft of more than 600 GB of confidential data, such as banking and other financial information, personal data of employees and customers, and information marked “secret”. AVEVA is a British multinational industrial software company headquartered in Cambridge, England, and operating as an autonomous business unit of Schneider Electric. It provides engineering, design, operations management, data visualization, asset performance, and cloud-based industrial intelligence solutions for sectors including oil and gas, power, chemicals, manufacturing, marine, mining, and infrastructure. AVEVA's technology helps thousands of enterprises worldwide optimize industrial processes, improve operational efficiency, and support digital transformation across complex engineering and asset lifecycle management.

BW Office World (bw-officeworld.de) is a German specialized online retailer providing comprehensive workspace and office supply solutions. Their catalog features office furniture, ergonomic chairs, presentation hardware, office technology, and everyday stationery from leading European brands. Serving both corporate B2B clients and individual consumers, the company emphasizes workplace ergonomics, dependable delivery across Germany, and expert support for office fit-outs.

Brüninghoff Group (brueninghoff.de) is a German construction and manufacturing company headquartered in Heiden, founded in 1974. The company specializes in turnkey project development, engineering, and the prefabrication of hybrid timber, concrete, and steel building systems. With around 700 employees, it strongly emphasizes sustainable, energy-efficient building methods for commercial, residential, and public architecture.
